nodes.text: Let $r\geq 2$ be finite and $\lambda$ be an infinite cardinal. Let $\kappa_\alpha$ be cardinals for all $\alpha<\gamma$. Is it true that\[2^\lambda \to (\kappa_\alpha+1)_{\alpha<\gamma}^{r+1}\]implies\[\lambda \to (\kappa_\alpha)_{\alpha<\gamma}^{r}?\]Here $+$ means cardinal addition, so that $\kappa_\alpha+1=\kappa_\alpha$ if $\kappa_\alpha$ is infinite.
